Compose a referent's monthly report

report_message.Rd

Two forms, told apart by the first word of the subject, which is what shows in a list of mail without opening anything: Tutto in ordine when there is nobody to look at, N da guardare otherwise. The mail is plain text, so the verdict is said again on the first line of the body, in capitals. N counts the people listed in full in the items to look at, and not the accesses activated, which are information; in the form to review the anomalies come first and the information after.

Usage

report_message(report, period)

Arguments

report

One referent's report, as report_assemble() builds it.

period

What report_month() answered.

Value

A list with subject, body, forma (in_ordine or da_guardare) and n.

Details

The year without access is not measured in phase 1, and the mail says so in both forms: an all-clear that covered an item nobody looked at would say something false. For the same reason the people of the referent that went to IT without being judged are counted in a line of their own, which changes neither the verdict nor the number in the subject: those say what was measured.

Italian above and English below, as every mail of the channel, since the address says nothing about which one its reader reads.
